slides.texte_overlay:
things emotionally intelligent
people never say out loud

calm down

they never tell an upset person to calm down. they ask what happened and simply listen, because feeling heard is what actually helps someone settle down.

i told you so

they never rub it in when they turn out to be right. they help fix the problem instead, because kindness matters far more to them than winning a point.

you always do this

they never use always or never in an argument. they talk about the one moment that hurt, which keeps things fair and so much easier to repair together.

that's boring

they never call someone's passion boring, because they're curious about nearly everything. a little daily learning makes every person's passion feel genuinely interesting.
slides.texte_sophia:
that's boring

they're curious about everything. the Sophia app turns it into one short lesson a day, a planet or a myth, and with 5 minutes of learning no passion ever sounds boring again.

slides.texte_overlay:
it's not a big deal

they never decide for others what should hurt. they accept that people feel things differently and simply show they understand, even if they don't agree.
